Published crate: msb_krun 0.1.39, SHA256 `0944407a6ae125935e64dcf9be666e56d2cca0907b9e34be6648784db453490c`; originating libkrun revision `2bd0f84ad0956f3032e0490d3b8512b6851eca12`. License: Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE`).

WI 0119 adds a typed, once-per-process `EmbeddedKernel` registry. The loader selects registered bytes only when its internal firmware path resolves to this executable or the internal `@embedded-kernel` marker; all other paths keep the published DSO behavior. The SDK still requires a real firmware path, so the executable path is internal transport until WI 0120 supplies an embedded origin. The kernel pointer is backed by static bytes for the process lifetime; the caller validates architecture, checksum, bounds and addresses before registration. This patch has no exported C symbol and does not use process symbol lookup.

`Cargo.toml.orig` is the published source manifest. `upstream.diff` applies to the published crate with `patch -p1`. Replace/remove this patch when WI 0120 adds a typed embedded kernel API through msb SDK/runtime and equivalent release builds pass.

**Verification status: unproven.** This typed registry loader is *not* the loader that booted on Apple Silicon in the strict-embed spike (`tools/oci-runtime-spike/strict-embed/embedded-loader.patch`, which used `Library::this()` and an exported `krunfw_get_kernel` symbol). No VM has been booted through this patch on any platform: the only Linux run stopped at `/dev/kvm` `ENOENT`. Keep the spike patch as the fallback reference until "first boot with the vendored patch" passes on Apple Silicon and Linux/KVM (blockers B-01/B-18). On x86_64 Linux the VMM maps the registered bytes directly as guest RAM, so awman registers a writable, 64 KiB-aligned heap copy rather than the read-only static (`src/engine/container/builtin/embedded/kernel.rs`); that path is also unbooted.
